carta-fund-performance.headline: Fund Performance now reads Carta through its current tools. Rebuild it so it keeps loading as Carta's connector changes.

carta-home-build.headline: The Skill directory now has a search box: type what you want to do and it shows the matching skills, or says when none match. Rebuild to get it.

carta-lp-summary.headline: When Carta Home opens the LP Summary, a Back to Home link at the top of the page takes you straight back.

carta-soi.headline: SOI now has an Investment Cash Flows tab: every dated investment, proceed and terminal value behind Deal IRR, grouped by company and fund, following the same fund, as-of and exited filters.

carta-workhub-build.headline: Workhub now lists the KYC forms waiting on you under KYC compliance, so you can open each one from here. Rebuild to see them.
